description: This file defines the UserCancelForm class in Drupal, providing a confirmation form for user account cancellation, including form building, submission handling, and related logic.

classes.name: UserCancelForm
classes.description: A form class for confirming user account cancellation in Drupal.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the confirmation question, customized if cancelling own account.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect to after cancellation.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a description for the cancellation confirmation, based on settings and account ownership.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the cancellation form with options for cancellation method, email confirmation, and notifications.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, performing account cancellation or sending confirmation emails.
